title: Automate changelog and onboard Ignis-13B v1.0 with perf profiles and metadata
author: Sara Liao
release_notes: Added Ignis-13B v1.0 to model registry with performance profiles and automated changelog generation. No breaking changes to existing models. Recommended default perf profile: ignis-13b/gpu-a100-24g/latency-optimized.
body: This PR onboards Ignis-13B v1.0 into the model registry and adds automated changelog and release notes generation for future model updates. Motivation: Ignis-13B is a promising open model with strong instruction-following performance on our evals and is requested by several customers for mid-tier production workloads. What this PR does: 1) Adds metadata JSON for ignis-13b v1.0 including model_id, architecture, tokenizer, checksum, licensing, and recommended default config. 2) Adds three perf profiles optimized for common deployment shapes: a) gpu-a100-24g/latency-optimized (single-instance low-latency), b) gpu-a10g/balanced-throughput (multi-instance moderate latency), c) cpu-quantized/low-cost (quantized CPU fallback). Each profile includes batch-size guidance, kv-cache settings, warmup sequences, and observed median p50/p95 token latencies from our perf lab. 3) Hooks the registry onboarding workflow into the changelog automation pipeline so that new model entries are automatically appended to the generated CHANGELOG.md and release notes metadata when the PR includes the metadata/perf files. 4) Adds unit tests for metadata validation and a perf profile sanity check that verifies required fields and basic numeric ranges. 5) Updates the model catalog index and docs snippet describing the model's recommended serving profiles. Backwards compatibility: The automation uses a safe opt-in tag in the metadata file (opt_in_changelog: true) so existing model entries are not modified unless explicitly enabled. Rollout plan: merge to main, run the registry generator in CI to validate generated changelog, and follow up with manual smoke tests on Dedicated staging. See linked linear ticket ENG-21234 for rollout checklist and additional evaluation data.

review_comments: Diego Morales: Overall looks good. Two requests: include quantization notes for CPU profile and add a small note about expected tokenization differences. Please add a numeric checksum for the tokenizer mapping.
Sara Liao: Added tokenizer_checksum and expanded the CPU profile notes. PTAL.
Priya Patel: CI failed on first run due to a flake in the registry generator test. Re-ran CI and it passed. One nit: change 'warmup-seq' to 'warmup_sequence' for consistency with other profiles.
Sara Liao: Updated perf profile keys to use warmup_sequence and added a short paragraph in docs about warmup tuning. Marking ready for final review.
Evan Chen: Approved and ran a quick smoke on staging Dedicated; p95 latency for a100 profile is within expected range. Approving for merge.
notes: This PR includes an opt-in flag opt_in_changelog in metadata to prevent accidental updates to the global changelog for models not intended to be public yet. The changelog-generator was updated to read this flag and to emit structured release notes into artifacts/release-notes/ignis-13b-v1.0.json for downstream publishing.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for metadata and perf profile validation. Integration tests exercise the changelog-generator end-to-end using a fixture model repo. Perf numbers were collected in perf-lab on 1xA100-40G and 4xA10G hosts with synthetic RPS and standard prompts; results included in perf-profiles files.
